stimulus.title: Smartphone Battery Usage
stimulus.content: A new smartphone battery has a capacity of 4000 mAh. When the phone is used for video streaming, the battery discharges at a constant rate of 400 mAh per hour. In standby mode, it discharges at a rate of 50 mAh per hour. A user starts with a fully charged battery (100%). They stream video for a certain number of hours and then leave the phone in standby mode.

study_content.theory: Linear relationships involve a constant rate of change. In this context, the battery capacity decreases by a fixed amount for every hour of activity. The formula for remaining capacity is Initial Capacity - (Rate x Time).

worked_examples.problem: How long will the phone last if left in standby mode from a full charge?

typical_errors: Adding the rates of discharge instead of multiplying by the respective times.
Confusing the capacity (mAh) with the percentage (%).
